semantics: Control preflights every requested stream before the first restart.
H265 is accepted only when the native capability list includes it.
RVD requires exact encoder and recreated ring-header agreement.
Control saves once and requires independent disk and final live agreement for every requested stream.
Any failure after the first restart attempt is partial_apply and requires reload before explicit retry.
A failed restart or post-restart readback remains recovery_required until full RVD bootstrap.
evidence_limit: SDK configuration and owner readback; no emitted bitstream or client interoperability claim
